home_hero_desc: Gulf Al Olaya is a progressive electro-mechanical contracting and general contracting company based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. We deliver end-to-end mechanical, electrical, civil, and industrial solutions with a personal commitment to quality that large firms simply cannot match.
home_about_title: A trusted contracting partner rooted in Riyadh, built on reliability.
home_about_desc: Headquartered in Riyadh, Gulf Al Olaya is a trusted electro-mechanical contractor, API 650 tank manufacturer, and industrial piping specialist. We deliver reliable, high-quality construction solutions through skilled teams, strong client partnerships, and a commitment to excellence from concept to completion.
home_cred_title: Trusted by clients. Proven on every project.
home_cred_desc: Built on decades of hands-on experience across Saudi Arabia, Gulf Al Olaya has grown from a dedicated contracting company into a multi-discipline construction and electro-mechanical powerhouse. Our commitment to quality, safety, and client satisfaction has driven us to deliver some of the most demanding projects in the Kingdom — on time, within budget, and to the highest standards.
home_biz_desc: We work across multiple sectors providing comprehensive mechanical, electrical, and civil engineering solutions.
home_featured_desc: We are proud of our strong portfolio of 60+ projects across 3 continents and 8 countries.
home_news_desc: Check out our latest news, press releases, events, and conferences.
home_careers_title2: We are always looking for talented, driven people who take pride in building something that lasts.
home_careers_desc: At Gulf Al Olaya, our people are our greatest strength. Whether you are an experienced engineer, a skilled technician, or a construction professional looking for your next challenge we offer a workplace where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contribution is valued. Join a team that builds more than structures we build careers.
home_contact_desc: Every great project starts with a conversation. Whether you have a fully scoped tender or just an early-stage idea, our team is ready to listen, advise, and find the right solution for you.
home_bottom_desc: From industrial piping to transmission lines, from civil works to MEP systems Gulf Al Olaya brings strength, skill, and commitment to every project we build.
sust_desc_4: We prioritize the health and safety of our 100+ employees with rigorous standards and continuous training.
about_hero_title: A Saudi company. A global standard.
about_hero_desc1: Gulf Al Olaya was founded on one belief that the best projects are built by people who care. From our headquarters in Riyadh, we have grown into one of the Kingdom's most trusted electro-mechanical and general contracting companies, delivering complex, high-value projects with the precision of specialists and the accountability of a committed partner.
about_hero_desc2: We are not just another contractor. We are the team that shows up, solves problems, and delivers every time
about_story_subtitle: We exist to build infrastructure that Saudi Arabia is proud of.
about_story_desc: Gulf Al Olaya was built on a simple but powerful idea that quality construction should not be reserved for the largest corporations. From our earliest projects to our most complex multi-discipline deliveries, we have consistently proven that a focused, skilled, and client-first team will outperform size every time.
vision_desc: Our vision is to be the Kingdom's most trusted name in electro-mechanical and multi-discipline contracting recognized not just for what we build, but for how we build it. We are growing with purpose, investing in our people, our systems, and our capabilities to meet the demands of Vision 2030 and beyond.
values_intro: Our values are the foundation of everything we do. They guide our decisions and define our culture.
key_facts_intro: Our clients and partners trust us to deliver beyond their expectations.
key_fact_1: Gulf Al Olaya maintains rigorous quality control across every discipline mechanical, electrical, civil, and industrial ensuring each project is delivered to specification without rework or shortcuts.
key_fact_2: From early-stage planning and design coordination through to final commissioning and handover, we manage the full project lifecycle so our clients have a single point of accountability.
key_fact_3: Our workforce holds recognized certifications across welding, piping, high-voltage works, and HSE operating to ASME, SEC, ARAMCO, and international standards on every project.
Contributing to saudi vision 2030: Built in Saudi Arabia, aligned with its future.
saudi_para_1: Gulf Al Olaya is deeply committed to the objectives of Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030. As a Riyadh based contractor, we actively contribute to the Kingdom's economic transformation through Saudization, local procurement, and investment in the next generation of Saudi construction professionals.
saudi_para_2: Our projects span the breadth of the Kingdom from urban commercial developments to critical infrastructure and every one of them is executed with a commitment to the efficiency, sustainability, and quality that Vision 2030 demands. We are not just building structures. We are building the Kingdom.
saudi_para_3: We continue to innovate and expand our capabilities within the Kingdom, serving as a beacon of excellence in the Middle East.

serv_mech_desc_short: Our Mechanical Division combines precision, expertise, and commitment to deliver high-quality HVAC, fire protection, and sheet metal solutions with exceptional efficiency and client satisfaction.
serv_elec_desc_short: Our Electrical Division provides end-to-end electrical solutions from low-voltage systems to high-voltage substations, delivering consistent quality, safety, and reliability across all sectors with expert teams and strict QA/QC.
serv_trans_desc_short: As a full EPC contractor, Gulf Al Olaya delivers complete overhead transmission line projects from design and procurement to construction and commissioning. We specialize in 132kV to 380kV systems with in-house engineering, QA/QC, and expert execution across Saudi Arabia.
serv_piping_desc_short: Our Industrial Piping Division fabricates and installs all types of industrial pipework, ranging from small-bore instrument tubing to large-bore process lines up to 90 inches in diameter. We manufacture piping spools at our Dammam facility and carry out on-site erection for oil, gas, fuel, chemical, water, and industrial utility applications.
proj_1_desc: Delivered complete civil and structural works for the Zulfi Mosque and adjacent residential project encompassing foundations, reinforced concrete frames, masonry, and architectural finishes to the highest standards of craftsmanship befitting a place of worship.
proj_2_title: Sultan Bin Abdul Aziz Humanitarian City
proj_2_desc: Executed comprehensive infrastructure works for the Sultan Bin Abdul Aziz Humanitarian City a landmark humanitarian project requiring strict site management, safety compliance, and zero disruption to live facilities.
proj_3_desc: Completed a full turnkey civil, structural, and interior finishing package for this commercial fast food outlet managing the entire project from structural shell to final fit-out, delivered on schedule to meet the client's operational launch timeline.
proj_4_desc: Delivered comprehensive electro-mechanical works for a staff housing development at Baha University, including full MEP installations, electrical fit-outs, and mechanical systems completed in coordination with Al Arab Co. to meet academic institution standards and handover requirements.
proj_5_cat: GRC Installation & Finishing Works Specialized Engineers & Contractors
proj_5_desc: Carried out specialist GRC (Glass Reinforced Concrete) installation and high-quality finishing works across this large-scale housing development in Al-Kharaj delivering precision facade elements and interior finishes that set the benchmark for residential quality in the region.
proj_6_desc: Constructed the complete civil works package for the Al Nazeem 132kV Substation including site preparation, reinforced concrete structures, cable trenches, control building, and boundary works enabling safe and reliable high-voltage electrical infrastructure for the region.
proj_7_desc: Ongoing installation and grid extension works for the high-voltage substation connections in Riyadh.
proj_8_desc: Completed comprehensive mechanical, electrical, and piping services installation for commercial facility.
proj_9_desc: Civil works and structural design connection for London local substation connection.
proj_10_desc: Extensive pipeline infrastructure works for waste and clean water utility lines in Cairo.
proj_11_desc: Electro-mechanical integration of industrial scale solar panel installation and grid routing.
proj_12_desc: Precision fabrication and setup of industrial API 650 storage tanks at oil facility.
proj_13_desc: Installation of high voltage overhead lines and structural tower foundations in Jeddah.
proj_14_desc: High efficiency heating, ventilation, and air conditioning setup for new transit line.
proj_15_desc: Specialist fabrication of industrial piping spools for chemical plant expansion.
sust_desc_1: We minimize waste, use materials efficiently, and apply best practices that reduce the environmental footprint of every project we deliver.
sust_desc_2: We priorities local talent, Saudi suppliers, and community-first practices contributing to the Kingdom's Saudization and economic development goals.
sust_desc_3: People are our most important asset. We uphold strict HSE standards on every site protecting our teams, our clients, and the communities around us.
sust_subtitle: At Gulf Al Olaya, sustainability is not an afterthought it is built into how we work. We are committed to delivering projects that are efficient, responsible, and aligned with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 goals for a greener and more sustainable future.
